$comment: What FiberBrowser opens, in one place: the open dialogs' filters (native, desktop app, in-page browser), the frontend's file dispatch (utils/supportedFiles.ts, utils/openFiles.ts) and the backend's checks (browser/services/supported_files.py) all read this file. Suffixes are lower case and matched at the end of the file name, longest first. 'sidecars' are index files: never opened on their own, used automatically when they sit next to their main file; a 'coordinate_index' (BAI, CSI, CRAI, tabix) is the one a remote file is opened with (a PacBio .pbi is not one). 'not_supported' gives the reason for formats people commonly try.

not_supported.why: CRAM files can't be opened; convert to BAM first (samtools view -b -o reads.bam reads.cram, then samtools index reads.bam)
SAM text files can't be opened; convert to an indexed BAM first (samtools sort -o reads.bam reads.sam, then samtools index reads.bam)
bedGraph can't be opened; convert it to bigWig first (bedGraphToBigWig)

WIG can't be opened; convert it to bigWig first (wigToBigWig)
